A very famous example of just such an exchange occurred between the Reverend Calvin Butts who highlights serious objects to black representation in gangster rap, and the artist known as Ice T (20C History Project 2014) who gave voice to an entire generation who completely misses the point. The question that remains is what the justifications of such representations are useful for now since slavery has been outlawed? What is less clear, is what to make of those African Americans who praise artists such as Tupac, Lizzo, Cardi B., Megan Thee Stallion. Like Ice T, they represent a view that has not grasped the similarity between using notions of black animality to justify, for instance, taking children away from their parents to sell to a sugar plantation. The question here is what artist representations of black animality now justify?
